title: Network Approach to Understanding Emotion Dynamics in Relation to Childhood Trauma and Genetic Liability to Psychopathology: Replication of a Prospective Experience Sampling Analysis
limitations: - Limited set of momentary emotional states to overcome convergence problems; - Negative emotion items subject to floor effects; - Sample may not be representative of overall population due to young, student participants; - Differences in means and variances between high CT group and other groups may have affected replicability.
notes: The paper does not mention preregistration. Code and data availability are not explicitly stated in the main text, but supplementary materials may contain this information. The study is a replication of a previous analysis, which may have been preregistered, but the current paper does not reference any preregistration.
